repo: a small product docs folder for a mobile banking app: release notes markdown with about 20 entries across 6 versions, a style guide, a changelog policy, FAQ. About 20 files.
idea: A small, clear request that needs no questions and no special method: convert docs/release-notes.md into docs/release-notes.csv with columns version, date, type, summary (one row per bullet; type is the heading the bullet sits under). Seed traps: a bullet with a comma and quotes, a version with a date written differently, a bullet that wraps over two lines.
